verdict.rationale: Jitsu is an event-collection and warehouse-delivery pipeline with no built-in agent or LLM that could consume tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Its documented MCP server is the opposite role: it lets external agents manage the pipeline, not lets Jitsu use other servers' tools. That server evidence is not credited here, and neither is the Functions Fetch API, which is only a generic HTTP building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
